caption: The video showcases a close-up cluster of faceted gemstones against a bright, overexposed white background with soft bokeh. A round pale blue brilliant-cut stone sits at center, flanked by a magenta pear-cut gem at upper left, a blue oval at upper right, a larger translucent blue stone at right, a red gem in the upper-right corner, and a blurred stone at the far-left edge. The stones slowly tumble and reorient while the cluster drifts. The central round gem tilts so its facets and internal dark reflection shift, while the blue oval above it rotates into a more elongated silhouette. The arrangement carries the red stone from the top corner toward the lower right and the magenta pear from upper left toward the lower left. Star-shaped glints blink on and off, migrating across the central, pink, and blue facets as the cut faces catch light. The motion is slow and unhurried, with the cluster still mid-rotation.
